snippet.title: Nightmare Circus - Official Steam Next Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
Nightmare Circus is a collision-driven action adventure indie game where you play as a Puppeteer trapped inside the Nightmare Realm. Use momentum-based combat, enhanced magic abilities, and precision positioning to defeat enemies and survive a twisted dark fantasy world.

Master collision combat mechanics.
Crash enemies into walls. Chain impacts. Control the battlefield.

With newly enhanced magic, amplify force, manipulate momentum, and turn every fight into a strategic spectacle of destruction.

Explore a hand-crafted nightmare world inspired by dark fantasy and theatrical horror. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and fight through a haunted realm built like a living stage.

If you enjoy action adventure games with physics-based combat, indie dark fantasy worlds, and unique collision mechanics, Nightmare Circus delivers a combat system built around impact and control.

🎪 Wishlist Nightmare Circus on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3227900/Nightmare_Circus/
